items.title: Appalachia Natural Gas Cash Slumps Toward $1 as Southeast Prices Top $4
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices finished mostly lower Wednesday as comfortable temperatures in the East sent Appalachia and Northeast hubs back toward $1/MMBtu, while lingering 90s across the Southeast produced some of the session’s most sizable gains.

items.title: November Natural Gas Futures Cling to $3 Level Into Close
items.summary: Natural gas futures searched for direction Wednesday, dipping below $3.000/MMBtu before finishing modestly higher on the day as traders weighed thinning production against weak shoulder season demand ahead of Thursday’s government inventory report.

items.title: Energy Executives Forecast Higher Natural Gas Prices Amid Iran War Unease
items.summary: Mounting uncertainty around the US-Israeli war with Iran is weighing heavily on oil and natural gas executives, according to the latest Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas energy survey.

items.title: Oil, Natural Gas Firms Bet ‘Interest Is So Strong’ in Venezuela, It Outweighs Political Risk
items.summary: The recent diplomatic thaw between Venezuela and neighboring Trinidad and Tobago marks a critical turning point for regional energy integration, and could mean more LNG from the Americas reaches an energy-hungry global market.

items.title: Another ‘Vote of Confidence’ in Ksi Lisims, Canadian LNG With Latest Supply Deal
items.summary: The Ksi Lisims LNG project being developed in British Columbia (BC) announced Wednesday it has signed a tentative deal to sell UK utility Centrica 1 Mt/y of the super-chilled fuel in another sign of growing momentum for Canadian natural gas exports.

items.title: Natural Gas Market Seeking Direction as Supply, Demand Both Trending Lower
items.summary: Subdued production lent bullish support to natural gas futures on Wednesday, offset by a largely unsupportive two-week weather outlook. The November New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) contract traded sideways as a result.

items.title: Heat, LNG Sustain Waha Natural Gas Prices Even as Permian Production Sets Records
items.summary: Natural gas spot prices in West Texas held firmly in positive territory through September as robust late-summer weather demand and elevated LNG feedgas consumption offset near-record Permian Basin production.

items.title: New Texas Natural Gas Storage ‘Quickly Absorbed Into the Market’
items.summary: Trinity Gas Storage has brought its 13 Bcf Phase II expansion online in East Texas, lifting working gas capacity to 37 Bcf as power and data center demand builds around the facility.

items.title: Kinder Morgan Accelerating Southeast Natural Gas Pipeline Buildout
items.summary: Kinder Morgan (KMI) is advancing multiple natural gas pipeline projects designed to shore up supply in the southeastern United States, where fast-growing power sector demand has fueled strong regional basis in recent months.
